PART 1: THE OPEN ROAD

This short adventure is original synthetic text written for Kit. It is not from any published book.

Road Opening
> You walk a dry wagon road. A broken wheel blocks the ruts.
A dry path runs on to the timber cave, area 1.

1. Timber Cave
> A timber cave opens in a sandy bank.
The dry path runs back to the road opening.
A ladder drops to area 2.

2. Store Niche
> Crates are stacked against the wall.
The ladder climbs back to area 1.
A passage runs to area 3.

3. Inner Cell
> One bandit stands by a shut door, a tin box at his feet.
The passage leads back to area 2.
The scouts in area 1 are only a mention, not a way.
